content: YouTube ToS: users agree to access content only via the YouTube player or other expressly authorized means and not to download, copy or store content unless YouTube shows a download button/link (Premium offline). Third-party downloading is a ToS breach (contract basis; enforcement against individuals rare). Cloud competitors (Klap, 2short.ai, OpusClip, Vizard) still offer paste-a-YouTube-link ingestion, positioned for creators clipping content they have rights to; being web services, Google Play policy does not constrain them.
